admitted_historical_physical_gate.admission_is_explicit_not_automatic: A successor that does not name a predecessor here admits no historical gate at all and falls back to requiring the gate under its own commit.

anti_laundering: The receipt is never rewritten, and the successor never claims to have produced it.
A receipt asserting the successor commit while carrying predecessor bytes fails the self-consistency binding between source_commit_sha and processing_source_commit.
A FAIL or incomplete gate is never admitted, under any commit.
does_not_authorize: re-running the physical gate to obtain a different result
admitting a gate over a different cohort, manifest, or authority
admitting a gate whose ten physical checks are not all present and PASS
any change to raw captures, capture receipts, or the frozen scientific design

gate_critical_closure.derivation: Call-graph reachability over first-party definitions seeded at the gate verdict definition, digesting the exact source text of each reachable definition plus each contributing file's executable module prologue. Identical machinery to the capture-critical closure, seeded differently.

lineage_is_not_evidence: Admission is NOT established by two commits belonging to a declared lineage, by an ancestry relation, or by a permitted-commit list. The admitted predecessor commit is named explicitly below and the closure equality is re-derived, not asserted.
principle: A physical-gate PASS receipt produced under predecessor processing commit P may be consumed by successor processing campaign S if and only if the GATE-CRITICAL CLOSURE is EQUAL at P and S. The gate-critical closure is the call-graph reachable, definition-granular closure seeded at the definition that computes the gate verdict. Equality means the successor's own code, run on the same immutable cohort, would compute the same verdict -- so re-executing it could only reproduce it. Full repository commit equality is NOT required and is NOT sufficient on its own.
question: May a Stage-2 processing successor consume the physical-gate PASS receipt that a PREDECESSOR processing freeze produced, without re-executing the physical gate?
required_conditions: receipt unit identity equals the manifest physical-gate unit
receipt authority sha256 equals the manifest authority binding
receipt manifest sha256 equals the live manifest bytes
receipt scientific run id equals the manifest run namespace
receipt durable uri equals the manifest-derived derived-namespace uri
physical_gates.required_checks equals the gate implementation's own check vocabulary
physical_gates.capture_units equals the authority scientific capture count
physical_gates.paired_trajectories equals the authority trajectory identity count
the gate's per-unit cohort identity equals the manifest capture unit identity set exactly
the gate's cohort capture-critical closure equals the authorized capture-critical closure
all admitted capture closures were equal when the gate ran
the gate's recorded processing_source_commit equals the receipt source_commit_sha
the receipt source commit is either the current processing commit, or exactly the predecessor commit named above
the gate-critical closure at the receipt's source commit equals the gate-critical closure at the current processing source
why_this_document_exists: OPTION_3_SPLIT_CAPTURE_PROVENANCE_FROM_PROCESSING_PROVENANCE resolved the same conflation for RAW CAPTURES: a capture is a physical measurement and a later processing edit cannot retroactively change what the camera saw. It was scoped to captures and says nothing about DERIVED evidence. The physical gate is derived: it is computed BY processing source. So the capture rule does not transfer by analogy, and the residual rule in the extraction stage -- require_durable_unit_receipt, whose contract is derived units and which therefore demands source_commit_sha == the processing commit -- refused the gate receipt the moment a downstream execution defect forced a successor freeze. That refusal is not a scientific control. It is the last surviving instance of the source-homogeneity proxy, on the derived side.
